items.title: Make resumeBreakerState accurately expose its counter-only reset contract
items.context: Remove the unused priorState parameter, update all three internal call sites, and preserve the existing human-ack reset behaviour. Observe and report any lifecycle rework or convergence anomalies encountered.
items.userSees: The convergence-breaker resume API no longer suggests that prior state influences a full reset, with existing reset behaviour unchanged.

happy.desc: Invoke the counter-only resumeBreakerState with representative current breaker counters after a frozen incident -> the returned state re-baselines every counter to those current values, clears frozen/trippedReasons/counterSnapshot, and restores autoRecoveriesSpent to 0; WHY: preserves the intentional human-ack reset behaviour while making the API contract truthful.

edge.desc: Invoke the counter-only reset with zero-valued current counters -> every baseline remains 0 and all reset fields still return to their clean defaults; WHY: proves the implementation derives the resumed state from counters without needing persisted prior-state data, including the lower boundary.

adversarial.desc: Build and run the convergence-breaker smoke after converting all production and smoke call sites to the one-argument counter-only signature -> TypeScript accepts no missed legacy two-argument call and the human-ack regression assertions pass; WHY: catches a silently retained misleading call site or an accidental change to resume semantics.
